notes: Pack labels on half sheets. Load › Print Pack Labels on Half Sheets… prints the pack labels twice the size, two 8½" × 5½" labels to a letter page, to cut apart on the dashed line: for sticker paper you cut yourself until the Avery 5164 sheets are in. Pack the rest packs in straight rows, the crew's way. Its first option, Straight rows, builds the truck row by row from the nose, each row wall to wall with one straight back so a strap across it holds.
